question: Can the unchanged v2 adapter generate executable, evidence-supported repairs for six preselected original training inputs under its original operations contract?
input_contract: Use the exact prompt messages from the indexed train.sft.jsonl record. It contains the original tracker system prompt and full conversation/intention_state/tool_receipts input. The canonical completion is preserved for scoring only; never pass it as part of the generation input.
execution: Apply strict operations parsing and the unchanged IntentStore to a restored exact original training prior. One call per case; no subsequent audit, normalization repair, hidden retry or altered label.
outcomes: Strict JSON and executable operations acceptance.
Focal owner/status correctness and full focal meaning (including text and qualifiers) after execution.
Focal repair operation and sufficiency of its cited raw evidence.
Preservation of all unrelated pre-existing requirements and correctness of ordinary latest-turn changes.
Exact canonical completion match as a descriptive formatting metric only; semantic equivalents may differ in text.
interpretation_rules: Failures show the selected training examples were not mastered under greedy generation; they do not quantify total training-set failure or identify the cause.
Success shows local fit on these exposed training examples; it does not prove generalization or overfitting.
Mixed results locate which native repair abilities were or were not reproduced here; do not label the whole model underfit or overfit from six examples.
This check is separate from the 12 new adapter-off audit calls versus 12 historical adapter-on audit calls. Do not merge denominators or treat it as another arm of that comparison.
stop_rule: Stop after the six assigned single-pass generations, retaining every failure. No prompt tuning, new data, retraining, model swap or output-dependent rerun is authorized by this protocol.
